:::{#def-validation-choice}
#### Validation choice

Given candidate [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure) $g_1, \ldots, g_L$,
the **validation choice** $\est{l}$
is the index of the candidate whose [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule),
fitted to the training set $\trainset$,
has the smallest [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
on the [validation set](#def-validation-set):

$$
\est{l} \eqdef \argmin_{l} \frac{1}{\abs{I_{\text{val}}}} \sum_{i \in I_{\text{val}}}
\sqf{g_l\paren{x_i; \trainset} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-validation-choice}

:::
